'''Solar Wind Squadron''' was a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] unit that served with the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]]. They were part of the task force of reinforcements that had been sent to protect [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] from an impending attack from the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. During the [[Battle of Adumar]] that followed, the squadron was split into two - half of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were tasked with helping the combined [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and Adumari forces in dealing with the Imperial [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]], while the other half attacked the fleet's [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Agonizer (starship)|''Agonizer'']], ''[[Retaliator]]'', and ''[[Master Stroke]]''.
